name: Alon Weiss
text: I never realized how slow and closed-off traditional science was until I discovered DeSci. The old system was built to slow us down.

name: Dr. Mei Zhang
text: OpenQuanta lets me publish genetic datasets instantly, with verifiable authorship. No more months of waiting for gatekeepers to say yes.

name: Carlos Ortega
text: The peer-review layer built on Solana is genius. I can trace every edit, every review, and every contributor — totally transparent.

name: Lara Kim
text: As an AI researcher, reproducibility is everything. Being able to attach code, data, and proofs to my NFT publication is a game-changer.

name: Dr. Yusef Adebayo
text: Our quantum paper reached 3x more readers in a week on OpenQuanta than in three months on traditional journals. That says it all.

name: Ananya Patel
text: Publishing here feels alive — data updates in real-time, and community feedback starts within hours. It’s how modern science should work.

name: Rafael Costa
text: Finally, a place where interdisciplinary work doesn’t get rejected for being 'too unconventional'. OpenQuanta values curiosity over conformity.

name: Dr. Hannah Müller
text: Verification on-chain gives my work instant credibility. Reviewers and readers can confirm it’s mine — no more disputes over priority.

name: Noah Singh
text: Funding microgrants directly through my research NFTs has opened new doors. Support now flows to the ideas themselves, not bureaucracy.

name: Isabella Rossi
text: OpenQuanta has turned publication into collaboration. Reviewers add insight, not rejection letters — and it all stays on-chain.
